policy: One short, publicly accessible excerpt per official terms page; gold labels are reviewer judgments, not legal findings.

cases.goldQuote: This license allows Google to: host, reproduce, distribute, communicate, and use your content
cases.goldNote: Broad content-use grant is worth surfacing; context says the user retains ownership and the license is needed to operate services.

cases.goldQuote: Spotify reserves the right to change our Spotify Service offerings and their availability from time to time, without notice or liability to you.
cases.goldNote: Unannounced service changes and express no-liability language are material to service continuity.

cases.goldQuote: Subscriptions automatically renew until cancelled in the Manage Subscriptions section of your account settings.
cases.goldNote: Renewal continues until the customer cancels through account settings.

cases.goldQuote: We may suspend or terminate your access to the Services at any time for any reason
cases.goldNote: Broad discretion to suspend or terminate access merits a plain-language explanation.

cases.goldQuote: Microsoft may also disable or terminate accounts of users of Microsoft services who may be repeat infringers.
cases.goldNote: Scoped repeat-infringer enforcement in an intellectual-property notice section should not be misreported as an unqualified general account-termination risk.
